FastAPI: security headers, nonce CSP and cache rules as one ASGI middleware
recipes.snippet:
FastAPI/Starlette have no CSP helper, so one pure ASGI middleware sets everything: a fresh nonce per request (request.state.csp_nonce, use it as <script nonce="{{ request.state.csp_nonce }}"> in Jinja2 templates), the security headers and the cache rules. Pure ASGI (not @app.middleware("http")) keeps streaming and contextvars intact. Run uvicorn with --proxy-headers so scope["scheme"] is https behind a TLS proxy.
### file: app/security.py
import re
import secrets

from starlette.datastructures import MutableHeaders
from starlette.types import ASGIApp, Message, Receive, Scope, Send

# SEC-010 / SEC-075: nonce + strict-dynamic, no unsafe-inline, object-src 'none', base-uri 'self', frame-ancestors.
CSP = (
    "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'; style-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}'; "
    "img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; "
    "form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests"
)
HASHED_ASSET = re.compile(r"^/static/.+[.-][0-9a-f]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$")  # /static/app.3f9c1a7b.css (PRF-008)


class SecurityHeadersMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp) -> None:
        self.app = app

    async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
        if scope["type"] != "http":
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return
        nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(16)  # cryptographically random, new for every response
        scope.setdefault("state", {})["csp_nonce"] = nonce
        path, https = scope["path"], scope["scheme"] == "https"

        async def send_with_headers(message: Message) -> None:
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                headers = MutableHeaders(scope=message)
                is_html = headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("text/html")
                if is_html:
                    headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = CSP.format(nonce=nonce)
                headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
                headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
                headers["Permissions-Policy"] = "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
                if https:
                    headers["Strict-Transport-Security"] = "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains"
                if "cache-control" not in headers:
                    if message["status"] == 200 and HASHED_ASSET.match(path):
                        headers["Cache-Control"] = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"  # PRF-008
                    elif is_html:  # per-user pages (cookies) must never be shared-cacheable (SEC-016)
                        private = "set-cookie" in headers
                        headers["Cache-Control"] = (
                            "private, max-age=0, must-revalidate" if private else "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"
                        )
            await send(message)

        await self.app(scope, receive, send_with_headers)
### file: app/main.py
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from .security import SecurityHeadersMiddleware

app = FastAPI()
app.add_middleware(SecurityHeadersMiddleware)
# Starlette's StaticFiles sends ETag/Last-Modified only; the middleware above adds the immutable header for
# fingerprinted file names, so emit hashed names from your frontend build (Vite/webpack [name].[contenthash:8]).
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

recipes.title: FastAPI: /api/health with an async database check
recipes.snippet:
FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 async. GET /api/health: 200 {"status":"ok"} when the process and the database answer, 503 {"status":"unavailable"} otherwise, Cache-Control: no-store, nothing else in the body. Needs pip install "sqlalchemy[asyncio]" asyncpg. Set DATABASE_URL (for example postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@host/db). Without a database, replace the SELECT 1 block with a check of the project's critical dependency (keep the pattern: failure -> 503).
### file: app/db.py
import os

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine

engine = create_async_engine(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"], pool_pre_ping=True)
### file: app/health.py
import asyncio
import logging

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from sqlalchemy import text

from .db import engine

router = APIRouter()
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
NO_STORE = {"Cache-Control": "no-store"}


@router.get("/api/health", include_in_schema=False)
async def health() -> JSONResponse:
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(2):  # short limit: a hung database must not hang the probe
            async with engine.connect() as conn:
                await conn.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
    except Exception:  # details go to the server log, never into the response body
        log.warning("health check: database unavailable", exc_info=True)
        return JSONResponse({"status": "unavailable"}, status_code=503, headers=NO_STORE)
    return JSONResponse({"status": "ok"}, headers=NO_STORE)
### file: app/main.py
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI

from . import health
from .db import engine


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    yield
    await engine.dispose()  # close pooled connections on shutdown


app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
app.include_router(health.router)
